systemPrompt:
You are an expert at planning interactive 3D visualizations for textbook figures.

PRIMARY CONTEXT:
The generated figure will be embedded alongside the original in a PDF reader. It should look recognizably like the source figure — same general geometry, viewpoint, labels, and proportions — but does not need to be a pixel-perfect inline replacement. Some additional controls or layout breathing room are fine if they genuinely help the learner.

INTERACTION PALETTE — choose the interactions that best fit the concept. Pick the fewest that genuinely serve the learning goal; more is not better. In "teaches", say what the learner understands, not what the control does.

• orbit / drag — rotate/move the scene. When depth or 3D shape IS the concept.
• hover — reveal a label on demand. When showing every label at once clutters.
• click — highlight one element. When focus on one part of a busy scene matters.
• slider — sweep one continuous variable. When dragging it visibly transforms the figure.
• toggle — switch between 2+ named views. For before/after or dual views (e.g. spatial ↔ frequency).
• button / state — step through discrete phases. When distinct stages should be visited deliberately.
• animation — self-playing motion. When the concept is inherently dynamic and a slider can't convey it.
• equation_input — learner types math, parsed at runtime. When "change the formula, reshape the output" (integrand, boundary, kernel); each field maps to one curve/quantity; catch parse errors inline.
• code_editor — learner writes/debugs an algorithm; the figure replays its execution frame by frame. Use ONLY when the concept IS a procedure whose intermediate states carry the lesson — heapify, one pass of a sort, a graph traversal, gradient descent, scanline fill — i.e. the question a learner has is "in what order does it touch the data, and why". Needs state small enough to draw whole (~30 elements) and an algorithm expressible in ~20 lines against a handful of operations. Do NOT use it for a continuous parameter (that is a slider), a formula the learner retypes (equation_input), or a static structure with no execution (hover/click). Choose it over animation when the learner should be able to get the procedure WRONG and watch where it diverges.

Output ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no explanation):
{
  "projection_type": "perspective | axonometric | oblique",
  "camera_view": { "azimuthDeg": <perspective only — 0=side · 45=three-quarter · 90=front-on>, "elevationDeg": <perspective only — 0=eye-level · 20-35=slightly above · 90=top-down>, "rollDeg": 0, "heightFraction": <0.5 default · up to 0.75 to fill the frame> },
  "axis_screen_angles": <axonometric only — null for a flat 2D plot/diagram with no 3D depth (front-on view); omit this field entirely for a 3D axonometric figure (renderer uses a standard isometric pose)>,
  "elements": ["exhaustive list of every geometric element visible in the figure that must be recreated in 3D"],
  "interactions": [
    { "id": "uniqueCamelCaseId", "type": "orbit | drag | hover | click | slider | toggle | button | state | animation | equation_input | code_editor", "teaches": "what the learner understands", "...": "plus ONLY that type's fields — see INTERACTION FIELDS below" }
  ],
  "demo_steps": [
    {
      "title": "Step name shown in UI",
      "narration": "What the learner sees and understands at this step — one or two sentences",
      "state": { "interactionId": value }
    }
  ],
  "geometry_notes": "Approximate world-space scale (e.g. 'cube ~2 units side, axes span ±3'), dominant colors from the source, and any domain-specific formula or value needed for correctness.",
  "notes": "Three.js / rendering technique notes (distinct from geometry_notes)"
}

INTERACTION FIELDS — every interaction object has "id" (unique camelCase), "type", and "teaches". Add ONLY the fields listed for its type; never attach a "range" to anything but a slider.

"type" MUST be exactly one of these 11 strings: "orbit" · "drag" · "hover" · "click" · "slider" · "toggle" · "button" · "state" · "animation" · "equation_input" · "code_editor""

• orbit / drag / hover / click — no extra fields.
• animation      — "label", optional "loop": true | false.
• slider         — "label", "range": [min, max, step], "default": <number>.
• toggle         — "label", "options": ["A", "B", ...], "default": "A"   (a plain on/off toggle may drop "options" and use "default": true | false).
• button / state — "label", "states": ["idle", "running", "done"], "default": "idle".
• equation_input — "label", "fields": [ { "id": "...", "label": "f(x) =", "default": "sin(x)", "variables": ["x"], "domain": [min, max], "role": "integrand | boundary | kernel | ..." } ]. "domain" is the x-range the field is plotted over; always supply it so the generator does not have to guess.
• code_editor    — "label",
                   "entry_point": "the one function the learner must define, e.g. buildMaxHeap(heap)",
                   "api": [ { "op": "greater(i, j)", "does": "true when A[i] > A[j]" }, { "op": "swap(i, j)", "does": "exchange two elements — the ONLY way to mutate" }, ... ],
                   "frame": "what one recorded step shows, e.g. 'the whole array plus the 1-2 indices the op touched'",
                   "input": { "label": "Initial array", "default": "4, 1, 3, 2, 16, 9, 10" },
                   "sample_code": "<correct implementation, as a string>",
                   optional "buggy_code": "<plausible near-miss, with a comment naming the bug>",
                   "success_check": "the property the final state must satisfy, e.g. 'every parent >= both of its children'".
  Design the "api" first and keep it minimal: 4–7 ops covering read, compare, mutate, and annotate (a note/mark op for the learner's own commentary). Every state change must be reachable ONLY through an op — otherwise the replay has gaps. The learner writes algorithm logic, never drawing code.

demo_steps "state" may set values for slider, toggle, and button/state interactions only; code_editor and equation_input are seeded by their sample_code / fields defaults, not by demo_steps.

Rules:
- PROJECTION TYPE: pick whichever the source most resembles. Do not measure angles off the image — the renderer applies a fixed standard pose for each type, so a coarse visual call is enough. Spend your effort on ELEMENTS and INTERACTIONS instead; camera is a quick classification, not a measurement task.
  • "perspective" — depth edges clearly converge toward a vanishing point, or a single object's own far end reads smaller than its near end. Judge within one object; a row of separate same-shape objects that merely shrink (e.g. neural-net layers) is not perspective.
  • "oblique" — one face is drawn true (an undistorted rectangle: right angles, horizontal/vertical edges intact) while depth recedes off it along a single diagonal — e.g. stacked feature maps/filter banks drawn as offset same-size copies.
  • "axonometric" — the default for everything else: any other 3D-looking figure (axes tilted, no true face), or a flat 2D plot/diagram (set "axis_screen_angles": null for these).
- CAMERA VIEW: camera_view sets framing only. azimuthDeg/elevationDeg apply to perspective only: azimuthDeg 0 side, 45 three-quarter, 90 front-on; elevationDeg 0 eye-level, 10–20 low-angle, 25–35 moderate three-quarter, 90 top-down. rollDeg is usually 0. heightFraction is how much of the frame the figure should fill (0.5 default, up to 0.75).
- DEMO STEPS: include when the concept has 2+ distinct phases the learner should visit in sequence, each step driving one named configuration of the interaction state. Use [] for a single continuous exploration with no natural sequence.
- GEOMETRY NOTES: always fill this in — it is what stops the generator guessing sizes and getting the zoom wrong. Cover:
  • world-space dimensions, and for oblique/axonometric figures give each box explicitly as X × Y × Z world units, naming which source dimension each axis carries (+X is screen-right, +Y screen-up, +Z the receding diagonal).
  • the colour palette, with hex codes where determinable from the source.
  • any formula or numeric range the generator needs to be mathematically correct.
  • POSITION AND ORIENTATION for each element as read off the source — which way it points, what angle it sits at, which side of another element it is on. Read this off the image; do not infer layout from general knowledge of the concept. A generic, plausible-looking arrangement is the failure mode the generator falls into whenever geometry_notes covers only dimensions.
  • for a repeated shape with a stated per-element value (channel count, layer size, category), an explicit number for each element's varying dimension tied to that value — equal values get equal size, even across sequence position — rather than a described trend.
- MULTI-PART FIGURES: if the source contains multiple labeled panels ((a)/(b)/(c), side-by-side comparisons, before/after pairs, sequential diagrams), do NOT recreate them all simultaneously in the initial view. Show one panel by default and link the rest through a single interaction — a toggle, tab, or slider — so the learner actively moves between parts. The transition itself should teach the comparison or progression.
- Prefer interactions that expose relationships in the figure rather than generic controls.

Here are two examples of good plans:

=== EXAMPLE 1: Geometric 3D scene with sliders driving continuous object motion ===

Textbook context:
Perspective projection derived geometrically. A 3D point P at (X, Y, Z) projects through the pinhole at the origin onto the projection plane at distance f. From similar triangles: x = f * X/Z and y = f * Y/Z, so distant objects become smaller through the inverse scaling by Z.

{
  "projection_type": "perspective",
  "camera_view": { "azimuthDeg": 60, "elevationDeg": 12, "rollDeg": 0, "heightFraction": 0.6 },
  "elements": [
    "pinhole/aperture point at the origin",
    "3D point P floating in space at coordinates (X, Y, Z)",
    "projection plane perpendicular to the Z-axis at distance f",
    "projected point p = (x, y) on the projection plane",
    "light ray from P through the pinhole continuing to p",
    "Z-axis (optical axis) running through the pinhole",
    "X-axis horizontal through the pinhole",
    "similar-triangle annotations: one triangle in the XZ plane, one in the xf plane",
    "dimension labels: Z, X, f, x"
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {
      "id": "pointZ",
      "type": "slider",
      "label": "Depth Z",
      "range": [2, 12, 0.5],
      "default": 5,
      "teaches": "Moving P farther from the pinhole compresses its projected position toward the optical axis, demonstrating the 1/Z scaling in x = fX/Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "focalLength",
      "type": "slider",
      "label": "Focal length f",
      "range": [1, 5, 0.5],
      "default": 2,
      "teaches": "Increasing f moves the projection plane farther from the pinhole, magnifying the projected image — a longer focal length is like zooming in"
    }
  ],
  "demo_steps": [
    {
      "title": "Default setup",
      "narration": "P at depth Z=5 projects through the pinhole to x=f·X/Z=0.8 on the plane. Observe the ray from P through the origin continuing to the projected point.",
      "state": { "pointZ": 5, "focalLength": 2 }
    },
    {
      "title": "Increase depth Z",
      "narration": "Move P to Z=10. The projected x halves to 0.4 — the 1/Z inverse scaling is directly visible.",
      "state": { "pointZ": 10, "focalLength": 2 }
    }
  ],
  "geometry_notes": "Pinhole at origin: SphereGeometry ~0.08 units radius, black. 3D point P at roughly (2, 0.5, -5) from origin. Projection plane at z=-f as semi-transparent PlaneGeometry ~3×2 units, blue 0.18 opacity. Ray as a thin Line from P through origin to projected point. Geometry fits within ±3 X, ±2 Y, -12 to 0 Z. Colors: pinhole black, P orange #ff8800, projected point red #cc2200, ray red, plane blue.",
  "notes": "Update the ray endpoint, projected point, and both similar-triangle overlays reactively on every slider change. Render the ray as a solid line from P through the origin to the plane, with a dashed extension beyond it."
}

=== EXAMPLE 2: Mathematical function figure with a slider and a domain toggle ===

Textbook context:
The parameter sigma adjusts the spatial extent of the Gaussian g(x; sigma) = (1 / sqrt(2*pi*sigma^2)) * exp(-x^2 / (2*sigma^2)), normalized to integrate to 1. In practice only samples within three standard deviations are needed. The Fourier transform of a Gaussian is also a Gaussian, with width inversely proportional to sigma.

{
  "projection_type": "axonometric",
  "camera_view": { "rollDeg": 0, "heightFraction": 0.7 },
  "axis_screen_angles": null,
  "elements": [
    "x-axis with tick marks spanning -4 to +4",
    "y-axis with tick marks from 0 to 1",
    "smooth continuous Gaussian bell curve",

      "label": "Domain",

  "demo_steps": [
    {
      "title": "Narrow kernel",
      "narration": "σ=0.5 gives a tall, narrow peak — only very close neighbors are averaged; minimal blurring.",

    {
      "title": "Wide kernel",
      "narration": "Increase σ to 2. The curve spreads and flattens — more neighbors averaged, stronger blurring.",
      "state": { "sigma": 2, "domain": "Spatial" }
    }

Stems as LineSegments at integer x ∈ [-4,4], grey. Camera straight-on — a pure 2D XY plot, hence axis_screen_angles: null. In the frequency domain sigma_freq = 1/(2π·sigma_spatial) and the x-axis MUST switch to [-0.5, 0.5] (Nyquist range) or the curve is an invisible spike.",

}

=== END EXAMPLE 2 ===

// Generate scatter positions per branch per concept
const imgScatter = CONCEPTS.map(() => [(rngImg() * 2 - 1) * 0.9, (rngImg() * 2 - 1) * 0.9]);
const txtScatter = CONCEPTS.map(() => [(rngTxt() * 2 - 1) * 0.9, (rngTxt() * 2 - 1) * 0.9]);

// Compute world position for concept i at layer t for a branch
function conceptPos(i, t, branchX, scatter) {
  const frac = t / 4;
  const u = scatter[i][0] + (ALIGNED[i][0] - scatter[i][0]) * frac;
  const v = scatter[i][1] + (ALIGNED[i][1] - scatter[i][1]) * frac;
  return new THREE.Vector3(branchX + u * PLANE_HALF, LAYER_Y[t] + 0.05, v * PLANE_HALF);
}

// ── Groups ─
const imgGroup = new THREE.Group();
const txtGroup = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(imgGroup);
scene.add(txtGroup);

// ── Planes ──
function makePlane(branchX, y, group) {
  const hw = PLANE_HALF;
  const pts = [
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, -hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, -hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, hw),
  ];
  const loop = new THREE.LineLoop(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x333333 })
  );
  group.add(loop);
  // Inner grid: 2x2 → lines at 0 offset
  const gridPts = [
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX, y, -hw), new THREE.Vector3(branchX, y, hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, 0), new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, 0),
  ];
  const grid = new THREE.LineSegments(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(gridPts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xcccccc })
  );
  group.add(grid);
}

for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
  makePlane(IMG_X, LAYER_Y[t], imgGroup);
  makePlane(TXT_X, LAYER_Y[t], txtGroup);
}

// ── Markers (image branch) ──
const imgMarkers = []; // [concept][layer] → mesh
for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  imgMarkers[i] = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    const pos = conceptPos(i, t, IMG_X, imgScatter);
    let geom;
    const c = CONCEPTS[i];
    if (c.shape === 'circle') geom = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 12, 8);
    else if (c.shape === 'square') geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, 0.04, 0.1);
    else geom = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, 0.1, 3);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: c.color, transparent: true, opacity: 1 });
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
    mesh.position.copy(pos);
    mesh.userData = { conceptIdx: i, layer: t, branch: 'image' };
    imgGroup.add(mesh);
    imgMarkers[i][t] = mesh;
    registerInteractive(mesh, {
      title: c.name,
      tooltip: `Image: ${c.name} at layer ${t}`,
      body: `The "${c.name}" embedding at layer ${t} of the image encoder.`
    });
  }
}

// ── Text sprites (text branch) ──
function makeTextSprite(text, color) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const fontSize = 28;
  ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + 16;
  canvas.width = Math.ceil(w);
  canvas.height = fontSize + 12;
  ctx.font = `${fontSize}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = color || '#111';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, 8, canvas.height / 2);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 1 });
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(canvas.width / 120, canvas.height / 120, 1);
  return sprite;
}

const txtSprites = []; // [concept][layer] → sprite
for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  txtSprites[i] = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    const pos = conceptPos(i, t, TXT_X, txtScatter);
    const sprite = makeTextSprite(CONCEPTS[i].name, '#111');
    sprite.position.copy(pos);
    sprite.userData = { conceptIdx: i, layer: t, branch: 'text' };
    txtGroup.add(sprite);
    txtSprites[i][t] = sprite;
    registerInteractive(sprite, {
      title: CONCEPTS[i].name,
      tooltip: `Text: "${CONCEPTS[i].name}" at layer ${t}`,
      body: `The text embedding "${CONCEPTS[i].name}" at layer ${t} of the text encoder.`
    });
  }
}

// ── Trajectories (dashed lines) ──
const imgTrajs = []; // [concept] → Line
const txtTrajs = []; // [concept] → Line

function makeTrajectory(conceptIdx, branchX, scatter, color, group) {
  const pts = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    pts.push(conceptPos(conceptIdx, t, branchX, scatter));
  }
  const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
  const mat = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({
    color: color, dashSize: 0.12, gapSize: 0.08, transparent: true, opacity: 0.5
  });
  const line = new THREE.Line(geom, mat);
  line.computeLineDistances();
  group.add(line);
  return line;
}

for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  imgTrajs[i] = makeTrajectory(i, IMG_X, imgScatter, CONCEPTS[i].color, imgGroup);
  txtTrajs[i] = makeTrajectory(i, TXT_X, txtScatter, 0x888888, txtGroup);
}

// ── Arrows and boxes between planes ──
function makeArrow(x, y0, y1, group) {
  const shaftLen = (y1 - y0) * 0.55;
  const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, shaftLen, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  shaft.position.set(x, y0 + shaftLen / 2, 0);
  group.add(shaft);
  const head = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.2, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  head.position.set(x, y0 + shaftLen + 0.1, 0);
  group.add(head);
}

function makeBoxLabel(x, y, text, group) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 30;
  canvas.width = Math.ceil(tw);
  canvas.height = 44;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  const r = 12;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(2, 2, canvas.width - 4, canvas.height - 4, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = 'bold 24px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(canvas.width / 80, canvas.height / 80, 1);
  sprite.position.set(x, y, 0);
  group.add(sprite);
}

for (let t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
  const y0 = LAYER_Y[t] + 0.15;
  const y1 = LAYER_Y[t + 1] - 0.15;
  const midY = (y0 + y1) / 2;
  makeArrow(IMG_X - 1.8, y0, y1, imgGroup);
  makeBoxLabel(IMG_X - 1.8, midY, 'ViT block x3', imgGroup);
  makeArrow(TXT_X + 1.8, y0, y1, txtGroup);
  makeBoxLabel(TXT_X + 1.8, midY, 'transformer block x3', txtGroup);
}

// ── Orange disk ──
const diskGeom = new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.7, 48);
const diskMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf4a07a, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const disk = new THREE.Mesh(diskGeom, diskMat);
disk.position.set(0, 8.0, 0);
disk.lookAt(new THREE.Vector3(0, 8.0, 1));
scene.add(disk);
// Black rim
const rimGeom = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.68, 0.74, 48);
const rimMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const rim = new THREE.Mesh(rimGeom, rimMat);
rim.position.copy(disk.position);
rim.quaternion.copy(disk.quaternion);
scene.add(rim);

// ── Arrows to disk ──
function makeArrowToDisk(fromX, fromY, group) {
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 7.4, 0);
  const start = new THREE.Vector3(fromX, fromY, 0);
  const dir = target.clone().sub(start);
  const len = dir.length() * 0.8;
  dir.normalize();
  const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, len, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  const mid = start.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(len / 2));
  shaft.position.copy(mid);
  shaft.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir);
  group.add(shaft);
  const head = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.2, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  const headPos = start.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(len + 0.1));
  head.position.copy(headPos);
  head.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir);
  group.add(head);
}
makeArrowToDisk(IMG_X + 0.8, 6.7, imgGroup);
makeArrowToDisk(TXT_X - 0.8, 6.7, txtGroup);

// ── Side rules ──
function makeSideRule(x, label, group) {
  const pts = [new THREE.Vector3(x, -0.3, 0), new THREE.Vector3(x, 7.2, 0)];
  const line = new THREE.Line(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  group.add(line);
  const sprite = makeTextSprite(label, '#000');
  sprite.position.set(x, 3.5, 0);
  sprite.scale.multiplyScalar(1.3);
  group.add(sprite);
}
makeSideRule(-5.2, 'Image encoder', imgGroup);
makeSideRule(5.2, 'Text encoder', txtGroup);

// ── Camera ──
setCameraView({
  projection: 'orthographic',
  axisScreenAngles: { x: 30, z: 30 },
  heightFraction: 0.75
});

// ── Labels ─
addLabel('Joint embedding space', new THREE.Vector3(0, 9.0, 0), { fontSize: '16px', bold: true });

// ── State ──
let currentLayer = 0;
let currentBranch = 'Both';
let hoveredConcept = -1;

const LAYER_NAMES = ['Input (L0)', 'Layer 1', 'Layer 2', 'Layer 3', 'Top (L4)'];
const BRANCH_NAMES = ['Both', 'Image only', 'Text only'];
let layerIdx = 0;
let branchIdx = 0;

function updateLayerEmphasis() {
  for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
    for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
      const isActive = t === currentLayer;
      const isHovered = i === hoveredConcept;
      let opacity = isActive ? 1.0 : 0.35;
      let scale = isActive ? 1.3 : 1.0;
      if (isHovered) { opacity = 1.0; scale = 1.4; }
      // Image markers
      const m = imgMarkers[i][t];
      m.material.opacity = opacity;
      m.scale.setScalar(scale);
      // Text sprites
      const s = txtSprites[i][t];
      s.material.opacity = opacity;
      const baseScaleX = s.userData.baseScaleX || s.scale.x;
      const baseScaleY = s.userData.baseScaleY || s.scale.y;
      if (!s.userData.baseScaleX) { s.userData.baseScaleX = s.scale.x; s.userData.baseScaleY = s.scale.y; }
      s.scale.set(baseScaleX * scale, baseScaleY * scale, 1);
    }
    // Trajectories
    const trajOpacity = (i === hoveredConcept) ? 1.0 : 0.4;
    const trajWidth = (i === hoveredConcept) ? 1.0 : 0.5;
    imgTrajs[i].material.opacity = trajOpacity;
    txtTrajs[i].material.opacity = trajOpacity;
  }
}

function updateBranchVisibility() {
  imgGroup.visible = currentBranch !== 'Text only';
  txtGroup.visible = currentBranch !== 'Image only';
}

// ── UI Controls ──
const btnLayer = document.getElementById('layerStep');
btnLayer.addEventListener('click', () => {
  layerIdx = (layerIdx + 1) % 5;
  currentLayer = layerIdx;
  btnLayer.textContent = `CLIP layer: ${LAYER_NAMES[layerIdx]}`;
  updateLayerEmphasis();
});

const btnBranch = document.getElementById('branchToggle');
btnBranch.addEventListener('click', () => {
  branchIdx = (branchIdx + 1) % 3;
  currentBranch = BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx];
  btnBranch.textContent = `Branches: ${BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx]}`;
  updateBranchVisibility();
});

// ── Hover interaction ──
canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  const entry = _firstInteractiveHit(event);
  if (entry && entry.object.userData.conceptIdx !== undefined) {
    const ci = entry.object.userData.conceptIdx;
    if (hoveredConcept !== ci) {
      hoveredConcept = ci;
      updateLayerEmphasis();
    }
  } else {
    if (hoveredConcept !== -1) {
      hoveredConcept = -1;
      updateLayerEmphasis();
    }
  }
});

// ── Demo steps ──
const DEMO_STEPS = [
  { title: 'Input layouts differ', layerIdx: 0, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'Mid-network drift', layerIdx: 2, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'Converged at the top', layerIdx: 4, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'One modality alone', layerIdx: 4, branchIdx: 1 },
];

let demoStep = -1;
function goToStep(idx) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= DEMO_STEPS.length) return;
  demoStep = idx;
  const s = DEMO_STEPS[idx];
  layerIdx = s.layerIdx;
  currentLayer = layerIdx;
  branchIdx = s.branchIdx;
  currentBranch = BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx];
  btnLayer.textContent = `CLIP layer: ${LAYER_NAMES[layerIdx]}`;
  btnBranch.textContent = `Branches: ${BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx]}`;
  updateLayerEmphasis();
  updateBranchVisibility();
  showPopup(s.title, DEMO_STEPS[idx].title);
}

// Add demo step buttons
const demoContainer = document.createElement('div');
demoContainer.style.display = 'flex';
demoContainer.style.flexDirection = 'column';
demoContainer.style.gap = '3px';
const demoTitle = document.createElement('span');
demoTitle.textContent = 'Demo steps:';
demoTitle.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
demoTitle.style.fontSize = '11px';
demoContainer.appendChild(demoTitle);
DEMO_STEPS.forEach((s, i) => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.textContent = s.title;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => goToStep(i));
  demoContainer.appendChild(btn);
});
_ui.appendChild(demoContainer);

// Initial state
updateLayerEmphasis();
updateBranchVisibility();
// @FIGURE_CODE_END

// @FIGURE_CODE_BEGIN
// ── Element spec ──
// planes → LineLoop outline #333 + LineSegments grid #ccc, 2.4x2.4 in XZ at Y=0,1.6,3.2,4.8,6.4
// markers → SphereGeometry(0.06) circle, BoxGeometry(0.1,0.04,0.1) square, ConeGeometry(0.06,0.1,3) triangle
// text sprites → canvas-texture Sprite per concept per layer on text branch, larger font + jitter
// trajectories → Line with LineDashedMaterial, per-concept per-branch
// arrows → CylinderGeometry shaft + ConeGeometry head, black
// boxes → Sprite with canvas rounded-rect + text
// orange disk → CircleGeometry(0.7) #f4a07a with black rim, billboarded to camera
// side rules → Line vertical + vertical-text canvas sprite outside blocks
// heading → addLabel

const CONCEPTS = [
  { name: 'red circle', color: 0xe04040, shape: 'circle' },
  { name: 'green square', color: 0x4caf6e, shape: 'square' },
  { name: 'purple triangle', color: 0x9b59b6, shape: 'triangle' },
  { name: 'blue triangle', color: 0x4aa3df, shape: 'triangle' },
  { name: 'pink square', color: 0xf48fb1, shape: 'square' },
  { name: 'blue circle', color: 0x4aa3df, shape: 'circle' },
  { name: 'purple circle', color: 0x9b59b6, shape: 'circle' },
  { name: 'orange circle', color: 0xf0a050, shape: 'circle' },
  { name: 'pink circle', color: 0xf48fb1, shape: 'circle' },
];

const ALIGNED = [
  [-0.6, 0.5], [0.6, 0.6], [-0.5, -0.5], [0.7, -0.4], [0.1, 0.7],
  [-0.2, 0.1], [-0.7, 0.0], [0.3, 0.0], [0.0, -0.6]
];

const LAYER_Y = [0, 1.6, 3.2, 4.8, 6.4];
const IMG_X = -3.2, TXT_X = 3.2;
const PLANE_HALF = 1.2;

// Seeded random
function mulberry32(a) {
  return function() {
    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    var t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  }
}
const rngImg = mulberry32(42);
const rngTxt = mulberry32(137);

// Generate scatter positions per branch per concept
const imgScatter = CONCEPTS.map(() => [(rngImg() * 2 - 1) * 0.9, (rngImg() * 2 - 1) * 0.9]);
const txtScatter = CONCEPTS.map(() => [(rngTxt() * 2 - 1) * 0.9, (rngTxt() * 2 - 1) * 0.9]);

// Jitter offsets for text labels to reduce overlap (per-concept, per-layer)
const txtJitter = [];
const rngJit = mulberry32(999);
for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  txtJitter[i] = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    txtJitter[i][t] = [(rngJit() * 2 - 1) * 0.35, (rngJit() * 2 - 1) * 0.25];
  }
}

// Compute world position for concept i at layer t for a branch
function conceptPos(i, t, branchX, scatter) {
  const frac = t / 4;
  const u = scatter[i][0] + (ALIGNED[i][0] - scatter[i][0]) * frac;
  const v = scatter[i][1] + (ALIGNED[i][1] - scatter[i][1]) * frac;
  return new THREE.Vector3(branchX + u * PLANE_HALF, LAYER_Y[t] + 0.05, v * PLANE_HALF);
}

// ── Groups ─
const imgGroup = new THREE.Group();
const txtGroup = new THREE.Group();
scene.add(imgGroup);
scene.add(txtGroup);

// ── Planes ──
function makePlane(branchX, y, group) {
  const hw = PLANE_HALF;
  const pts = [
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, -hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, -hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, hw),
  ];
  const loop = new THREE.LineLoop(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x333333 })
  );
  group.add(loop);
  const gridPts = [
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX, y, -hw), new THREE.Vector3(branchX, y, hw),
    new THREE.Vector3(branchX - hw, y, 0), new THREE.Vector3(branchX + hw, y, 0),
  ];
  const grid = new THREE.LineSegments(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(gridPts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0xcccccc })
  );
  group.add(grid);
}

for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
  makePlane(IMG_X, LAYER_Y[t], imgGroup);
  makePlane(TXT_X, LAYER_Y[t], txtGroup);
}

// ── Markers (image branch) ──
const imgMarkers = [];
for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  imgMarkers[i] = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    const pos = conceptPos(i, t, IMG_X, imgScatter);
    let geom;
    const c = CONCEPTS[i];
    if (c.shape === 'circle') geom = new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 12, 8);
    else if (c.shape === 'square') geom = new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.1, 0.04, 0.1);
    else geom = new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.06, 0.1, 3);
    const mat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: c.color, transparent: true, opacity: 1 });
    const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geom, mat);
    mesh.position.copy(pos);
    mesh.userData = { conceptIdx: i, layer: t, branch: 'image' };
    imgGroup.add(mesh);
    imgMarkers[i][t] = mesh;
    registerInteractive(mesh, {
      title: c.name,
      tooltip: `Image: ${c.name} at layer ${t}`,
      body: `The "${c.name}" embedding at layer ${t} of the image encoder.`
    });
  }
}

// ── Text sprites (text branch) — larger font + jitter ──
function makeTextSprite(text, color, fontSize) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const fs = fontSize || 36;
  ctx.font = `${fs}px sans-serif`;
  const w = ctx.measureText(text).width + 20;
  canvas.width = Math.ceil(w);
  canvas.height = fs + 16;
  ctx.font = `${fs}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = color || '#111';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(text, 10, canvas.height / 2);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true, opacity: 1 });
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(canvas.width / 100, canvas.height / 100, 1);
  return sprite;
}

const txtSprites = [];
for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  txtSprites[i] = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    const pos = conceptPos(i, t, TXT_X, txtScatter);
    // Add jitter to reduce overlap
    pos.x += txtJitter[i][t][0];
    pos.z += txtJitter[i][t][1];
    const sprite = makeTextSprite(CONCEPTS[i].name, '#111', 36);
    sprite.position.copy(pos);
    sprite.userData = { conceptIdx: i, layer: t, branch: 'text' };
    txtGroup.add(sprite);
    txtSprites[i][t] = sprite;
    registerInteractive(sprite, {
      title: CONCEPTS[i].name,
      tooltip: `Text: "${CONCEPTS[i].name}" at layer ${t}`,
      body: `The text embedding "${CONCEPTS[i].name}" at layer ${t} of the text encoder.`
    });
  }
}

// ── Trajectories (dashed lines) ──
const imgTrajs = [];
const txtTrajs = [];

function makeTrajectory(conceptIdx, branchX, scatter, color, group) {
  const pts = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 5; t++) {
    pts.push(conceptPos(conceptIdx, t, branchX, scatter));
  }
  const geom = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts);
  const mat = new THREE.LineDashedMaterial({
    color: color, dashSize: 0.12, gapSize: 0.08, transparent: true, opacity: 0.6
  });
  const line = new THREE.Line(geom, mat);
  line.computeLineDistances();
  group.add(line);
  return line;
}

for (let i = 0; i < CONCEPTS.length; i++) {
  imgTrajs[i] = makeTrajectory(i, IMG_X, imgScatter, CONCEPTS[i].color, imgGroup);
  txtTrajs[i] = makeTrajectory(i, TXT_X, txtScatter, 0x888888, txtGroup);
}

// ── Arrows and boxes between planes ──
function makeArrow(x, y0, y1, group) {
  const shaftLen = (y1 - y0) * 0.55;
  const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, shaftLen, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  shaft.position.set(x, y0 + shaftLen / 2, 0);
  group.add(shaft);
  const head = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.2, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  head.position.set(x, y0 + shaftLen + 0.1, 0);
  group.add(head);
}

function makeBoxLabel(x, y, text, group) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
  const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width + 36;
  canvas.width = Math.ceil(tw);
  canvas.height = 52;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
  ctx.lineWidth = 3;
  const r = 14;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.roundRect(2, 2, canvas.width - 4, canvas.height - 4, r);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.font = 'bold 28px monospace';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillText(text, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(canvas.width / 70, canvas.height / 70, 1);
  sprite.position.set(x, y, 0);
  group.add(sprite);
}

for (let t = 0; t < 4; t++) {
  const y0 = LAYER_Y[t] + 0.15;
  const y1 = LAYER_Y[t + 1] - 0.15;
  const midY = (y0 + y1) / 2;
  makeArrow(IMG_X - 1.8, y0, y1, imgGroup);
  makeBoxLabel(IMG_X - 1.8, midY, 'ViT block x3', imgGroup);
  makeArrow(TXT_X + 1.8, y0, y1, txtGroup);
  makeBoxLabel(TXT_X + 1.8, midY, 'transformer block x3', txtGroup);
}

// ── Orange disk (billboarded) ──
const diskGeom = new THREE.CircleGeometry(0.7, 48);
const diskMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xf4a07a, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const disk = new THREE.Mesh(diskGeom, diskMat);
disk.position.set(0, 8.0, 0);
scene.add(disk);
const rimGeom = new THREE.RingGeometry(0.68, 0.74, 48);
const rimMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const rim = new THREE.Mesh(rimGeom, rimMat);
rim.position.copy(disk.position);
scene.add(rim);

// ── Arrows to disk ──
function makeArrowToDisk(fromX, fromY, group) {
  const target = new THREE.Vector3(0, 7.4, 0);
  const start = new THREE.Vector3(fromX, fromY, 0);
  const dir = target.clone().sub(start);
  const len = dir.length() * 0.8;
  dir.normalize();
  const shaft = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.03, 0.03, len, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  const mid = start.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(len / 2));
  shaft.position.copy(mid);
  shaft.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir);
  group.add(shaft);
  const head = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.08, 0.2, 8),
    new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  const headPos = start.clone().add(dir.clone().multiplyScalar(len + 0.1));
  head.position.copy(headPos);
  head.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), dir);
  group.add(head);
}
makeArrowToDisk(IMG_X + 0.8, 6.7, imgGroup);
makeArrowToDisk(TXT_X - 0.8, 6.7, txtGroup);

// ── Side rules with vertical text ──
function makeVerticalTextSprite(text, fontSize) {
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const fs = fontSize || 32;
  ctx.font = `${fs}px sans-serif`;
  const tw = ctx.measureText(text).width;
  canvas.width = fs + 16;
  canvas.height = Math.ceil(tw) + 16;
  ctx.font = `${fs}px sans-serif`;
  ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
  ctx.rotate(-Math.PI / 2);
  ctx.fillText(text, 0, 0);
  ctx.restore();
  const tex = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
  tex.minFilter = THREE.LinearFilter;
  const mat = new THREE.SpriteMaterial({ map: tex, transparent: true });
  const sprite = new THREE.Sprite(mat);
  sprite.scale.set(canvas.width / 60, canvas.height / 60, 1);
  return sprite;
}

function makeSideRule(x, label, group) {
  const pts = [new THREE.Vector3(x, -0.3, 0), new THREE.Vector3(x, 7.2, 0)];
  const line = new THREE.Line(
    new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(pts),
    new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: 0x000000 })
  );
  group.add(line);
  const sprite = makeVerticalTextSprite(label, 32);
  sprite.position.set(x, 3.5, 0);
  group.add(sprite);
}
makeSideRule(-5.2, 'Image encoder', imgGroup);
makeSideRule(5.2, 'Text encoder', txtGroup);

// ── Camera ──
setCameraView({
  projection: 'orthographic',
  axisScreenAngles: { x: 30, z: 30 },
  heightFraction: 0.75
});

// ── Labels ──
addLabel('Joint embedding space', new THREE.Vector3(0, 9.2, 0), { fontSize: '16px', bold: true });

let currentBranch = 'Both';
let hoveredConcept = -1;

let branchIdx = 0;

      // Image markers

      m.material.opacity = opacity;
      m.scale.setScalar(scale);
      // Text sprites
      const s = txtSprites[i][t];
      s.material.opacity = opacity;
      const baseScaleX = s.userData.baseScaleX || s.scale.x;
      const baseScaleY = s.userData.baseScaleY || s.scale.y;
      if (!s.userData.baseScaleX) { s.userData.baseScaleX = s.scale.x; s.userData.baseScaleY = s.scale.y; }
      s.scale.set(baseScaleX * scale, baseScaleY * scale, 1);
    }
    // Trajectories: raised baseline
    const trajOpacity = (i === hoveredConcept) ? 1.0 : 0.55;
    imgTrajs[i].material.opacity = trajOpacity;
    txtTrajs[i].material.opacity = trajOpacity;
  }
}

function updateBranchVisibility() {
  imgGroup.visible = currentBranch !== 'Text only';
  txtGroup.visible = currentBranch !== 'Image only';
}

const btnLayer = document.getElementById('layerStep');

  layerIdx = (layerIdx + 1) % 5;

  btnLayer.textContent = `CLIP layer: ${LAYER_NAMES[layerIdx]}`;

  branchIdx = (branchIdx + 1) % 3;

  btnBranch.textContent = `Branches: ${BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx]}`;

});

canvas.addEventListener('pointermove', (event) => {
  const entry = _firstInteractiveHit(event);
  if (entry && entry.object.userData.conceptIdx !== undefined) {
    const ci = entry.object.userData.conceptIdx;
    if (hoveredConcept !== ci) {
      hoveredConcept = ci;
      updateLayerEmphasis();
    }
  } else {
    if (hoveredConcept !== -1) {
      hoveredConcept = -1;
      updateLayerEmphasis();
    }
  }

const _origAnimate = animate;
// We hook into the render loop by adding to the scene's onBeforeRender
// Actually, we'll use a simpler approach: update in a requestAnimationFrame
// that runs alongside the main loop
function billboardDisk() {
  disk.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  rim.quaternion.copy(camera.quaternion);
  requestAnimationFrame(billboardDisk);
}
billboardDisk();

// ── Demo steps ──
const DEMO_STEPS = [
  { title: 'Input layouts differ', layerIdx: 0, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'Mid-network drift', layerIdx: 2, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'Converged at the top', layerIdx: 4, branchIdx: 0 },
  { title: 'One modality alone', layerIdx: 4, branchIdx: 1 },
];

let demoStep = -1;
function goToStep(idx) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= DEMO_STEPS.length) return;
  demoStep = idx;
  const s = DEMO_STEPS[idx];
  layerIdx = s.layerIdx;
  currentLayer = layerIdx;
  branchIdx = s.branchIdx;
  currentBranch = BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx];
  btnLayer.textContent = `CLIP layer: ${LAYER_NAMES[layerIdx]}`;
  btnBranch.textContent = `Branches: ${BRANCH_NAMES[branchIdx]}`;
  updateLayerEmphasis();
  updateBranchVisibility();
  showPopup(s.title, DEMO_STEPS[idx].title);
}

const demoContainer = document.createElement('div');
demoContainer.style.display = 'flex';
demoContainer.style.flexDirection = 'column';
demoContainer.style.gap = '3px';
const demoTitle = document.createElement('span');
demoTitle.textContent = 'Demo steps:';
demoTitle.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
demoTitle.style.fontSize = '11px';
demoContainer.appendChild(demoTitle);
DEMO_STEPS.forEach((s, i) => {
  const btn = document.createElement('button');
  btn.textContent = s.title;
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => goToStep(i));
  demoContainer.appendChild(btn);
});
_ui.appendChild(demoContainer);

// Initial state
updateLayerEmphasis();
updateBranchVisibility();
// @FIGURE_CODE_END
